verdict.rationale: Neon publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. A probe fetched https://neon.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The Management API llms.txt index, also confirmed live by probe, links the spec at neon.com/api_spec/release/v2.json "for request/response validation and codegen". Missing for 10: no hands-on validation of the spec's completeness or use in codegen, and no independent community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://neon.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
